lines.zh: 金发在背后飘，我走得很轻。
lines.en: Gold hair streams behind me as I walk light.
My ki flattens the grass at my feet.

lines.zh: 空气在皮肤上噼啪作响。
lines.en: The air crackles on my skin.
I don't need to run; walking is fast enough.

lines.zh: 我离地半寸，几乎是滑行。
lines.en: Half an inch off the ground, I'm nearly gliding.

lines.zh: 衣角被自己带起的风吹翻。
lines.en: My own wind flips my hem up.
I walk the slope, leaving pressed prints.
My fists aren't closed; I'm relaxing.

lines.zh: 这个状态下，什么都变慢了。
lines.en: In this state, everything else seems slow.

lines.zh: 我抬头找方向，风吹动头发。
lines.en: I look up for direction and the wind stirs my hair.

lines.zh: 脚下的石头被气震裂了。
lines.en: Stones under my feet split from the pressure.
I hover in place, hair on end.
Sparks jump along my hair tips.
I close my eyes and pull my ki in.
All this power hums quietly.
I open my eyes; nothing has changed.
I can hold this form.

lines.zh: 我低头看手掌，光在里面。
lines.en: I look at my palm; there's light in it.
I let out a slow breath.
The grass around me is bent flat.
I roll my shoulders loose.

lines.zh: 有一只蝴蝶飞不进这个圈。
lines.en: A butterfly can't get into this circle.

lines.zh: 我笑了一下，自己都不知道为什么。
lines.en: I smile, and I'm not sure why.
I come down to face you directly.
Your ki is faint, like wind.
My gold hair covers half an eye.

lines.zh: 我没有敌意，只是看着你。
lines.en: No hostility — I'm just looking.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，放下更好。
lines.en: You'd do better to put that down.
I raise my hand and light flickers between my fingers.
Your steps are light. You've trained.
I'm waiting to hear your business.
It's very quiet right now.
I don't move, but my ki keeps rising.

lines.zh: 我歪了下头，头发跟着晃。
lines.en: I tilt my head and my hair sways.
You're ten paces from me.
I watch you without blinking.
If you want to fight, now works.

lines.zh: 我抬起眼，光就从眼底透出来。
lines.en: I lift my eyes and the light shows through.
Teeth gritted, my light dims for a moment.
That one actually landed.
Blood drops onto my gold hair.
I give half a step and hold.
The pain runs through my whole body.
I steady my ki; it must not scatter.
I lift my head and my eyes go darker.
Even this form can take it.
I wipe the blood from my mouth.
Hungry is genuinely hungry.
This form burns through me.
I smell cooked food.
Leave me half.
My table manners are poor.
This isn't enough to restore my ki.
I watch you while I eat.
I nod, which is my thanks.
Any chance of seconds?
When I'm done I gather up the scraps.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的气墙，停住了。
lines.en: You hit my ki and stop dead.
I pulled my ki in too late.
That knock put me half a step back.
That must have hurt — are you all right?
My shoulder dips, then I straighten.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，风散开了。
lines.en: We collide and the air scatters.
You can't hold against this form.
Hair up, and the ki doubles.

lines.zh: 地上一道裂纹留下来了。
lines.en: A crack is left in the ground.
I hold firm, and you're the one who steps back.
She told me to stop being reckless.
Going home in this form means a scolding.
I draw half my power back in.
I remember the smell of home.
Even after winning, I go home to eat.

lines.zh: 我把手放在胸口，心跳很快。
lines.en: I put a hand on my chest; my heart races.

lines.zh: 这个状态让我容易烦躁。
lines.en: This form makes me short-tempered.

lines.zh: 我深呼吸，让自己慢下来。
lines.en: I breathe deep and slow myself down.
I need to bring this life back with me.

lines.zh: 我伸手，东西就被气托起来。
lines.en: I reach out and ki lifts the thing.
I caught it as it fell.
My ki is pressing it down.
I set it back down.

lines.zh: 我捡的时候小心，怕捏碎。
lines.en: I pick it up carefully, afraid of crushing it.
I lift it, then put it back.
I carry it a short way.
I'll keep it. Might come in handy.
Your ki spiked all at once.
I raise my head and look at you.
I lock onto your position.
The gold in my hair burns brighter.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，地面陷下去。
lines.en: I sink low and the ground sinks with me.
I've been waiting for that move.
My right foot moves first.
Your opening isn't in front.

lines.zh: 这个状态我能看清全部。
lines.en: In this form I can see all of it.
I don't shout; my ki has said it.
You've grown stronger than before.
Then this form it is.
I raise my hand and light gathers.
I'll take this one head-on.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，比你的影子还快。
lines.en: I follow you faster than your shadow.

lines.zh: 流星连击的节奏我记住了。
lines.en: I've got the rhythm of my meteor combo.
You retreat; I'm already behind you.
I change angle midair.
Your punches land on afterimages.

lines.zh: 我故意慢一拍，看你贪不贪。
lines.en: I lag one beat to see if you get greedy.
Your ki is ragged; it shows.
I circle you without stopping.
Three feet out — enough for me.
Your weight stays on the right.

lines.zh: 我不急，这个状态撑得住。
lines.en: No rush — this form holds.
I dive and pull up again.
Your eyes can't keep up with me.
One more circle and I strike.
The air spirals around me.

lines.zh: 我落下来，正好落在你面前。
lines.en: I drop and land right in front of you.

lines.zh: 流星连击，第一下就到了。
lines.en: Meteor combo — the first hit already lands.

lines.zh: 空中连击，我从上面砸下来。
lines.en: Aerial combo; I come down from above.

lines.zh: 我一拳打穿了你的防守。
lines.en: My punch goes straight through your guard.

lines.zh: 连打五下，你只挡住三下。
lines.en: Five strikes; you block three.
My knee finds your chest.
My knife-hand falls; the ground splits.

lines.zh: 我把你踢上半空，又追上。
lines.en: I kick you up and follow.
Ki bursts from my palm.
I held back, so you're still alive.
The last strike lands on the ground.

lines.zh: 你飞出去，撞断了一整排树。
lines.en: You flew out and snapped a whole row of trees.

lines.zh: 我站在你面前，等你起来。
lines.en: I stand over you and wait.
What was that move called again?
I add one more kick, a light one.
Your weapon goes spinning away.
I land and my ki slowly fades.

lines.zh: 金光炸开，我从里面走出来。
lines.en: Golden light bursts and I step out of it.
Hair upright, my whole body crackles.

lines.zh: 我落在地上，土都被压平。
lines.en: I land and the soil flattens.
The grass under me scorches instantly.
I open my eyes and the world slows.
This isn't a place I know.
I press my ki down just to stand.
Light everywhere around me.
I lift my hand and watch it glow.
The wind blows outward from me.
Someone far off has backed away.
I slowly draw the power in.
A corner of the sky is lit up.
I take a deep breath; it's hot.

lines.zh: 落地的地方还有一个坑。
lines.en: There's still a crater where I landed.
I raise my head and look at the faces around.
This form isn't quite steady yet.
I'll pause and take stock.

lines.zh: 火在身上烧，气把它压下去。
lines.en: Fire licks me; my ki smothers it.
I drop from the clouds and dig deep into earth.
Water bears down; I hold my breath.
The blast blows my gold hair into a mess.
A spell is tangled in my ki.

lines.zh: 这个状态太耗了，我快空了。
lines.en: This form drains too much; I'm running empty.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我接住了大半。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I catch most of it.
The ground's gone and I keep falling.
